name: Officers' Schafkopf
summary: Two-player open-card variant of Bavarian Schafkopf used to learn trumps, with half the cards face-up.
rules_text: Played with 32 Bavarian cards minus Sixes. Deal 4 down cards to each player, then 4 up cards to non-dealer. Non-dealer announces a contract: Suit Solo (Acorns, Leaves, Hearts, Bells with 4 Obers and 4 Unters plus suit as trumps) or Wenz (only Unters trumps). Dealer gets 4 up cards and may double (Stoß). Deal remaining 8 down and 8 up so each has two rows of 4 down each topped by up cards, or deal as hands. Non-dealer leads with an upcard. Must follow suit if possible, else trump or discard. When an upcard is played, the downcard beneath is turned face up and becomes playable after the trick. Winner leads next. 120 card-points in pack. Declarer needs 61 to win, defender 60.
rating_reason: Two-player trick-taking, hidden information, clear strategy
